parameters.content:
## Daily Postgres archive check

Uses pg_stat_archiver. The database role needs pg_monitor.
Slack gets an OK or STALE summary every day.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  current_database() AS database_name,
  pg_is_in_recovery() AS in_recovery,
  last_archived_time,
  last_failed_time,
  archived_count,
  failed_count,
  CASE
    WHEN last_archived_time IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - last_archived_time))
  END AS seconds_since_last_archive,
  pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database())) AS database_size,
  now() AS checked_at
FROM pg_stat_archiver
